_how: Photographs from outside Wikimedia Commons, chosen by eye and approved by the owner on a review page before they ship. Read by scripts/fetch-photos.mjs, where a pick wins over every Commons tier and over NO_PHOTOGRAPH. Stored byte for byte as served (iNaturalist "large"), never resized or cropped.

western-tragopan.title: Western Tragopan — Kullu, IN-HP, IN
western-tragopan.why: Approved by the owner by eye (3 Oct 2026). A wild male in the Great Himalayan National Park, Kullu, beside a female koklass pheasant; the only wild photograph in India on iNaturalist. The location rules out the Sarahan pheasantry.

sangai.title: Sangai — Manipur, IN
sangai.why: Approved by the owner by eye (3 Oct 2026), option A of three framings of the same wild stag at Keibul Lamjao, Manipur; identified to the subspecies Rucervus eldii eldii. Every other sangai photographed in India is in a zoo.

clouded-leopard.title: Mainland Clouded Leopard — Arunachal Pradesh, IN
clouded-leopard.why: Approved by the owner by eye (3 Oct 2026). A wild clouded leopard on a night camera trap, Namdapha National Park, Arunachal Pradesh (not Meghalaya), with the monitoring programme's label printed on the photograph.

none.markhor: No wild markhor photographed in India exists on iNaturalist: the four Indian records are zoo animals (Darjeeling, Nainital) and every wild one is in Pakistan. The card stays without a photograph.
